subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “The light in one school hallway stayed on all night.”?
options: Within two months, the school used less electricity.
Our school bell used to be very loud.
Two students sat there to study after school.
The next day, Ella brought two rulers to school.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Within two months, the school used less electricity.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Our school bell used to be very loud.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Two students sat there to study after school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The next day, Ella brought two rulers to school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Within two months, the school used less electricity.」，答案為「Within two months, the school used less electricity.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Within two months, the school used less electricity.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
